activation_policy.hard_profile_eligible: an exact narrow phrase that names the observable relation and is compatible with the frozen user intent
activation_policy.bm25f_or_embedding_only: optional candidate evidence only and never hard eligible
activation_policy.collision_rule: one visible relation must have one primary owner; adjacent profiles may contribute only non-conflicting components
activation_policy.adult_subject_boundary: when a person is visible, describe only observable adult appearance and action; do not infer identity, protected traits, health, attractiveness, occupation or relationship status

candidate_pack_policy.independence_rule: render qualification arms freeze their own input and must not borrow candidates or repaired prompt text from another arm

nonvisual_claim_policy.permitted_visual_proxy: an explicitly requested combination of structure, action, light, material and capture relation
nonvisual_claim_policy.forbidden_pixel_claim: aesthetic quality, popularity or platform success
real popularity, visitor count or trend rank

nonvisual_claim_policy.runtime_treatment: request-owned context with visible interaction candidates
nonvisual_claim_policy.permitted_visual_proxy: shared task, spatial orientation, luggage or a transit boundary

nonvisual_claim_policy.runtime_treatment: requested metadata plus visible material or spatial proxies

candidate_family_reference_policy: underscore-delimited values are existing or proposed candidate IDs; natural-language values are descriptive concepts to resolve or add during implementation

actions: taking one snack from a basket

required_checks: broad aesthetic and place terms activate zero hard profiles
each narrow exact phrase resolves to one primary owner
mirror reflection does not trigger wet-surface reflection
fantasy portal does not trigger architectural threshold
rail-dispatch work does not trigger traveler waiting
palace courtyard or costume-only hanok does not trigger domestic hanok topology
generic loft or rusty prop does not trigger adaptive reuse
missing any one required component fails the corresponding render contract
candidate IDs are unique and all existing reuse IDs resolve
candidate-pack arrays retain source, core, prompt, request, image and review lineage

evaluation_contract.prompt: required but insufficient for visual success
evaluation_contract.render: five of five required gates per hard profile at thumbnail and native scale where specified

implementation_sequence: add a source-owned emotional-place extension instead of directly editing generated shared data
reuse and enrich existing IDs before adding relation atoms
add only exact-term hard profiles whose five components have one stable owner
regenerate shared tags, visual-profile index and semantic search shards through the repository build path
add Korean and English positive, broad-negative, collision and component-ablation tests
run structural, routing and retrieval validation
freeze independent render arms and record full hash lineage
review rendered pixels and keep user judgment separate

sources.limitation: a scene-recognition representation does not prescribe an aesthetic prompt taxonomy
dataset attributes are not a quality score and do not cover every culturally specific scene relation
architectural graph properties do not by themselves prove a depicted action
a small action-recognition experiment is used only as a decomposition principle
17 female millennial participants are not a prevalence sample for Korea or all social-media users
a municipal lifestyle article is a local case source, not a platform-wide ranking
a still image cannot prove cognition, engagement quality or memory
hanok forms vary by region, period, household and building type
heritage conservation principles support decomposition but do not certify any generated space as authentic heritage
